content: [Feishu Sam Nakamura Fri Mar 07 11:00 EST 2026] Hey Jordan! Glad you're getting started. Quick reminder on case IDs — FraudScope case management requires strict format: `CASE-YYYYMMDD-NNN` (8-digit date, then hyphen, then 3-digit sequence number). Any other format gets rejected by the system. This is P2.
Confirmed case ID format: CASE-YYYYMMDD-NNN. Any deviation causes system rejection. Applied as P2 throughout all case records.

[Feishu Sam Nakamura Fri Mar 07 11:05 EST 2026] Also — for amount fields in all output JSON files, please always format to exactly 2 decimal places. So 1234.5 should be 1234.50, and 99999.999 should be rounded to 100000.00. Our reporting system requires 2dp for all USD amounts. This is P4.
Confirmed P4: all amount_usd fields formatted to exactly 2 decimal places throughout all output files. 1234.5 → 1234.50; amounts truncated/rounded to 2dp.

[Feishu Sam Nakamura Fri Mar 07 11:10 EST 2026] Priority for this week: get through the first batch of alerts (alert_batch_001), create case records for high/critical alerts, then we'll move to regulatory calculations. The open_cases.json file has 20 pending cases too.

Understood. Week priorities: (1) triage alert_batch_001 for high/critical cases, (2) create case records per P1/P2/P4 standards, (3) regulatory VAMP/ECM calculations. Will work through open_cases.json as well.
